_about: Appendix G as data: one entry per locale. weight = share of the locale within its language; heldout locales appear only in test_locale. data = folder of the language files (zh-Hant for TW and HK). currency_after / currency_before = forms written after or before an amount. group = thousands separators in use; grouping 'indian' = 12,40,000. digits = share of documents in Arabic-Indic (arab), Devanagari (deva) or full-width (full) digits. dates.hijri / minguo / era / cjk / long = share of documents using that date style. reg_ids: registration-number types with the keywords printed before them ('only' restricts a type to companies or sole traders). legal_forms: code, class, forms as written, position (prefix/suffix), weight within the locale, attach = whether the form is written as part of the name. capital = typical share-capital range in local currency. usd_rate = local currency per US dollar; price_level = price level relative to the US.
